PVC.Title: Victory Counter
PVC.Overlay.Hide: Hide for me (reopen from the Token controls)
PVC.Overlay.HiddenFromPlayers: Hidden from players — click to reveal
PVC.Overlay.VisibleToPlayers: Visible to players — click to hide
PVC.Overlay.SetHint: Type a number and press Enter to set this counter
PVC.Panel.Title: Victory Counter Controls
PVC.Panel.NoChallenge: No challenge is running. Configure the fields below and start one.
PVC.Panel.ChallengeTitleHint: Shown to everyone at the top of the counter. Leave blank to use the default name.
PVC.Panel.TrackFailuresHint: Adds a second track. The challenge is lost when the failure threshold is reached.
PVC.Panel.VisibleToPlayersHint: When off, only GMs see the counter and progress chat cards are whispered.
PVC.Confirm.RestartContent: "{title}" is currently running at {successes} successes and {failures} failures. Starting a new challenge replaces it and resets both counts to zero. You can undo this immediately afterwards.
PVC.Confirm.ResetContent: Successes and failures will be set back to zero. The challenge name and thresholds are kept.
PVC.Confirm.EndContent: "{title}" will end and the counter will disappear from every player's screen.
PVC.Confirm.EndNote: Nothing else in the world is changed. Use Undo to bring the challenge back.
PVC.Notify.GMOnly: Only a Gamemaster can change the victory counter.
PVC.Notify.WriteFailed: The victory counter could not be saved. Check the console for details.
PVC.Notify.NoChallenge: No victory challenge is currently running.
PVC.Notify.FailuresDisabled: Failure tracking is turned off for this challenge.
PVC.Notify.OverlayHidden: Victory counter hidden. Reopen it from the Token controls.
PVC.Notify.NowVisible: The counter is now visible to players.
PVC.Notify.NowHidden: The counter is now hidden from players.
PVC.Settings.Challenge.Name: Active Challenge Data
PVC.Settings.Undo.Name: Undo Snapshot
PVC.Settings.OverlayHidden.Name: Overlay Hidden Locally
PVC.Settings.OverlayCollapsed.Name: Overlay Collapsed Locally
PVC.Settings.OverlayOffset.Name: Counter Drag Offset
PVC.Settings.OverlayPosition.Name: Counter Anchor
PVC.Settings.OverlayPosition.Hint: Where the victory counter starts on your screen. You can also drag it by its title bar; double-click the bar to snap back to this anchor. Personal preference — it does not affect other players.
PVC.Settings.OverlayScale.Name: Counter Scale
PVC.Settings.OverlayScale.Hint: Size multiplier for the victory counter on your screen.
PVC.Settings.PostChat.Name: Post Progress to Chat
PVC.Settings.PostChat.Hint: Post a chat card whenever the challenge changes. Cards are whispered to GMs while the challenge is hidden from players.
PVC.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug Logging
PVC.Settings.Debug.Hint: Write verbose diagnostics to the browser console, prefixed with [pf2e-victory-counter].
